full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY DILG OPINION NO. 34 S. 16 March 2010 VICE-MAYOR ARIEL M. TUBIERA Aritao, Nueva Vizcaya Dear Vice-Mayor Tubiera: 2010 This has reference to your earlier letter requesting our assistance relative to the continuous practice of Mayor Lucita L. Tan, Aritao, Nueva Vizcaya of signing documents and authorizing disbursement of funds appropriated for the operations of the Sangguniang Bayan. In reply thereto, please be informed that we had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 03, series of 2008, dated 05 February 2008. Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 03, series of 2008 for your ready perusal. We hope this settles your concern. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORIW OF THE SECRETARY: . JESUS DOQU Director III, egal Servi Copy furnished: Regional Director Rolando L. Rafael DILG-Region 11 Carig, Tuguegarao City Cagayan Ls/17
